sentences.text: Sudip Sen & Ors vs Unknown on 11 August, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
11.08.2023 Serial no. 44 [G.S.D] Crr 98 of 2023 In the matter of : Sudip Sen & Ors.
... ... Petitioners
This revisional application earlier appeared on 9 th June, 2023, when none represented the petitioner.
Today, when the matter is called, also, none represented the petitioner.

This revisional application has been preferred challenging the proceedings arising out of Behala P.S.
case no. 349 of 2021 dated 14.12.201.
The said case was registered for investigation under provisions of Section 498A/406/313/34 of the I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of the D.P. Act.
Record reflects that charge-sheet has been submitted before the jurisdictional Court.
Having regard to the ingredients of the offences being available in the charge-sheet and the accompanying documents, I am not inclined to interfere with the further continuance of the proceedings.
Pending application, if any, is also dismissed.

Parties to act on a server copy of this order, duly collected from the official website of the Hon'ble High Court,
Calcutta.
Urgent Photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties, subject to compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
